The binding-review status records the owner's earlier full-file check; mere file existence would not establish that status.

conclusion: The earlier receipt-to-loaded-plan/configuration/raw-output linkage gap is addressed in the new helper and its v2 combiner/audit entrypoints, with exact binding-review records for three completed source runs. Reviewed publication still requires a complete passing 16-run collection and the website owner's separate release admission.
